test_read_ctrl: test read_ctrl function matches MuJoCo C mj_readCtrl reference with linear and ZOH interpolation
test_read_sensor: test read_sensor function matches MuJoCo C mj_readSensor reference with linear interpolation
test_read_sensor_arbitrary_times: test read_sensor function reads sensor values at arbitrary query times against MuJoCo C reference
test_init_ctrl_history: test init_ctrl_history function sets actuator control history buffer correctly with custom values
test_init_sensor_history: test init_sensor_history function sets sensor history buffer correctly with custom values and phase
test_read_sensor_second_index: test read_sensor function for sensor index greater than zero without out-of-bounds errors
test_actuator_history_only: test actuator with delay zero records history but applies control immediately
test_sensor_history_only: test sensor with delay zero records history but reports current value
test_multi_actuator_delay: test multiple actuators with different delay values produce correct actuator forces
test_multi_sensor_delay: test multiple sensors with different delay values produce correct sensor data
test_actuator_delay: test actuator delay with multiple worlds and varying delay and nsample parameters
test_sensor_delay: test sensor delay with multiple worlds and varying delay and nsample parameters
test_actuator_interp: test actuator delay with linear and cubic interpolation against MuJoCo C reference
test_sensor_interp: test sensor delay with linear and cubic interpolation against MuJoCo C reference
test_read_ctrl_cubic: test read_ctrl function with cubic interpolation matches MuJoCo C reference
test_sensor_delay_interval: test sensor delay combined with interval parameter against MuJoCo C reference
test_sensor_delay_multi_dim: test multi-dimensional sensor with delay against MuJoCo C reference
test_init_ctrl_history_monotonicity: test init_ctrl_history raises ValueError on non-monotonic or equal times
test_init_sensor_history_monotonicity: test init_sensor_history raises ValueError on non-monotonic times
test_state_save_restore_actuator: test save and restore history state produces identical actuator delay results
test_state_save_restore_sensor: test save and restore history state produces identical sensor delay results
test_insert_and_read_at_middle_time: test inserting values at specific times and reading at intermediate times with interpolation
test_init_replace_on_collision: test re-initializing history with same times replaces existing values
test_long_actuator_delay_wrapping: test actuator delay circular buffer wrapping over many simulation steps
test_long_sensor_delay_wrapping: test sensor delay circular buffer wrapping over many simulation steps
test_filter_with_delay: test actuator with filter dynamics and delay matches MuJoCo C reference
test_integrator_with_delay: test actuator with integrator dynamics and delay matches MuJoCo C reference
test_get_data_into_history: test get_data_into copies history data from device back to host correctly
test_state_history_get_set: test get_state and set_state correctly serialize and deserialize history state
